newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: IMF says agreement reached with Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: IMF says agreement reached with Pakistan.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund official said on Wednesday an agreement had been reached with Pakistan that would allow an IMF mission to recommend immediate resumption of financial aid to Islamabad.

"Agreement has been reached on all policy matters between the visiting mission of International Monetary Fund and the government of Pakistan on stabilisation and reform programme," a the IMF's resident representative said in a statement.
"The agreement is based on the measures already announced by the government on October 22, 1996," the statement said.

"This will form the basis for the mission's recommendations to reactivate the stand-by agreement and would trigger immediate resumption of financial support by the fund to Pakistan," said the statement by the IMF representative, Shamsuddin Tareq.
